outlook.statement: The Board of Directors and the Management of the Company are working on various strategies to scale up the operations of the Company.

NBFC sector projected to grow at 14% compounded growth over ensuing two years; NBFC AUM estimated to have grown 16-18% in FY2023-24 and 14-17% in FY2024-25, crossing INR 32 trillion by March 2025; sector fundamentally strong with prudent provisioning, low leverage, readiness for credit expansion; NBFC share in total credit rose from 16.4% (Dec 2022) to 29.1% (Feb 2023); Research and Markets projects NBFC sector CAGR of 18.5% between 2021-2026.
